description.summary: protocol for relative pointer motion events

protocol.description: This protocol allows clients to receive relative pointer events that are not obstructed by monitor edges or other pointer barriers.

interface.name: zwp_relative_pointer_manager_v1
interface.description: A global interface used for getting a relative pointer object for a wl_pointer.

interface.name: zwp_relative_pointer_v1
interface.description: A relative pointer shares focus with its associated wl_pointer and emits relative motion whenever such motion is applicable.
